findings.latin: Deinde quaeritur de aeternitate
findings.current: membahas kekekalan Allah
findings.suggested: membahas kekekalan
findings.why: The Latin prooemium says only 'eternity'; the scope of a3-a6 (aevum, participated eternity) is wider than God's eternity.

findings.latin: negatio non est de ratione nisi eorum quae sunt deficientia
findings.current: negasi hanya layak bagi apa yang berkekurangan
findings.suggested: penyangkalan hanya termasuk pengertian hal-hal yang bercacat
findings.why: Unified terms: negatio → penyangkalan, deficiens → bercacat, de ratione → termasuk pengertian (also 'negasi' ×2 in ad 1).

findings.latin: Praeterea, plures dies ... secundum revelationem mysterii temporibus aeternis taciti ... Ergo aeternitas non est tota simul
findings.current: (no 'Selanjutnya') ... misteri yang tersembunyi sejak kekekalan ... kekekalan tidak sepenuhnya serentak
findings.suggested: Selanjutnya, ... misteri yang dirahasiakan selama waktu-waktu yang kekal ... kekekalan tidak utuh sekaligus
findings.why: The objection argues from the plural 'eternal times', which the English singular 'from eternity' destroys; the Latin has 'Praeterea'; the conclusion must use the defined term 'utuh sekaligus'.

findings.latin: sicut ... oportet nos venire ... quod nihil aliud est quam numerus prioris et posterioris in motu ... eius quod est omnino extra motum
findings.current: sebagaimana kita sampai ... yang tidak lain adalah ukuran sebelum dan sesudah ... apa yang berada di luar gerak
findings.suggested: sebagaimana kita mesti sampai ... bilangan sebelum dan sesudah ... apa yang sama sekali berada di luar gerak
findings.why: Aristotle's definition of time is numerus, not mensura (the English 'measure' contradicts the first half of the same sentence); oportet and omnino restored; apprehensio → tangkapan.

findings.latin: ut dicitur in IV Physic. ... nec principium aut finem habere potest
findings.current: (no reference) ... ia tidak mempunyai awal dan tidak mempunyai akhir
findings.suggested: seperti dikatakan dalam Phys. iv ... ia tidak dapat mempunyai awal ataupun akhir
findings.why: The English drops the authority and the modal potest, which governs both successionem and principium aut finem.

findings.latin: id quod est in aeternitate, est interminabile
findings.current: apa yang kekal itu tanpa batas
findings.suggested: apa yang ada dalam kekekalan itu tanpa batas
findings.why: Thomas speaks of what is in eternity (measured by it), not of 'the eternal' as such.

findings.latin: nisi per remotionem compositionis
findings.current: kecuali dengan menyingkirkan lawannya
findings.suggested: kecuali dengan meniadakan susunan
findings.why: What is removed is composition (the point of the simplicia/composita contrast), not 'the opposite'; remotio → peniadaan per unified terms.

findings.latin: non solum est ens, sed vivens, et ipsum vivere se extendit quodammodo ad operationem, non autem esse
findings.current: bukan hanya berada, melainkan juga hidup; dan hidup mencakup kegiatan
findings.suggested: bukan hanya sesuatu yang ada, melainkan juga sesuatu yang hidup; dan hidup itu sendiri dengan cara tertentu mencakup kegiatan
findings.why: Ens/vivens are nouns (glossary §C: ens → sesuatu yang ada), kept distinct from esse later in the sentence; quodammodo was dropped.

findings.latin: metaphorice
findings.current: secara kiasan
findings.suggested: secara metaforis
findings.why: Unified terms (metaphorice → secara metaforis).

findings.latin: ipsum tempus, quod est successivum ... ad removendum tempus
findings.current: yang berlangsung silih berganti ... untuk menyingkirkan gagasan waktu
findings.suggested: yang berturut-turut ... untuk menyingkirkan waktu
findings.why: Unified term successivum → berturut-turut; 'gagasan' is an English addition (no ratio in the Latin).

findings.latin: usus est nomine possessionis
findings.current: kita memakai kata "kepemilikan"
findings.suggested: Boethius memakai kata "kepemilikan"
findings.why: The subject of usus est is Boethius, author of the definition, not 'we'.

findings.latin: Sed aeternitas est aliquid factum, dicit enim Boetius
findings.current: Padahal, Boethius berkata
findings.suggested: Akan tetapi, kekekalan adalah sesuatu yang dibuat, sebab Boethius berkata
findings.why: The English drops the minor premise of the syllogism, so the quotations prove nothing; also dici de → dikatakan tentang (unified).

findings.latin: Sed Deus est ante aeternitatem, ut dicitur in libro de causis, et post aeternitatem; dicitur enim Exod. XV, quod dominus regnabit in aeternum et ultra
findings.current: seperti dikatakan Aristoteles (De Causis), "Allah ada sebelum kekekalan dan Ia ada sesudah kekekalan", sebab ... (Kel 15:18)
findings.suggested: Allah ada sebelum kekekalan, seperti dikatakan dalam buku De Causis, dan sesudah kekekalan, sebab ada tertulis ... (Kel 15:18, Vulg.)
findings.why: The Liber de causis is anonymous and supports only 'before eternity'; 'after eternity' is proved from Exodus, whose 'et ultra' is Vulgate-only (TB: 'kekal selama-lamanya').

findings.latin: nulla alia res sit sua duratio, quia non est suum esse
findings.current: sebagaimana tidak ada sesuatu yang lain yang merupakan keberadaannya sendiri
findings.suggested: sebab tidak ada sesuatu yang lain yang merupakan keberadaannya sendiri
findings.why: Quia is causal: no creature is its own duration because it is not its own esse; the English 'as' makes it a mere parallel.

findings.latin: de aeternitate participata
findings.current: kekekalan yang dimiliki dengan mengambil bagian
findings.suggested: kekekalan yang diperoleh melalui partisipasi
findings.why: Unified terms (participatum).

findings.latin: dicit Hieronymus, ad Marcellam
findings.current: Hieronimus berkata (Ep. ad Damasum, xv)
findings.suggested: Hieronimus berkata dalam suratnya kepada Marcella
findings.why: The Latin names the letter to Marcella; the English substitutes another source.

findings.latin: sicut in Psalmo dicuntur montes aeterni
findings.current: bukit-bukit disebut "kekal" (Mzm 75:5)
findings.suggested: gunung-gunung disebut "kekal" (Mzm 76:4; Vulg. 75:5)
findings.why: Montes are mountains, and Catholic Mzm 75:5 is 'Jangan mengangkat tandukmu'; Vulg. Ps 75:5 = Hebrew 76:5 = Catholic 76:4 (the ayat.json pattern confirms Catholic = Hebrew minus one for one-verse titles). Re-run ayat.py to confirm.

findings.latin: licet corruptibilia sint ... participant de ratione aeternitatis ... Angeli et beati
findings.current: walaupun menurut kodratnya dapat binasa ... hakikat kekekalan ... orang-orang yang berbahagia
findings.suggested: walaupun dapat binasa ... pengertian kekekalan ... para kudus di surga
findings.why: 'In nature' is an English addition; unified terms ratio → pengertian and beati → para kudus di surga.

findings.latin: secundum illud Iob XXIV, ad nimium calorem transibunt ab aquis nivium ... secundum illud Psalmi, erit tempus eorum in saecula
findings.why: Catholic Mzm 80:16 is 'Mereka telah membakarnya dengan api'; Vulg. Ps 80:16 = Catholic 81:15 (confirm with ayat.py); the Job wording is Vulgate-only (TB: 'Air salju dihabiskan oleh kemarau').

findings.latin: quendam modum veritatis ... est in intellectu ... in intellectu aeterno
findings.current: suatu modus kebenaran ... ada dalam pikiran ... dalam pikiran yang kekal
findings.suggested: suatu cara kebenaran ... ada dalam intelek ... dalam intelek yang kekal
findings.why: Unified terms (modus → cara; intellectus → intelek); the sentence itself ends with 'intelek ilahi', so the term must be the same throughout.

findings.latin: videtur constituere rationem aeternitatis, quod sit idem indivisibiliter se habens
findings.current: hakikat kekekalan tampaknya ialah bahwa ia adalah hal yang sama dan tak terbagi
findings.suggested: pengertian kekekalan tampaknya ialah bahwa ia tetap sama dan tidak dapat dibagi
findings.why: Unified terms ratio → pengertian, indivisibile → tidak dapat dibagi.

findings.latin: haec est differentia per accidens, et non per se
findings.current: hanya menghasilkan perbedaan yang aksidental, bukan perbedaan yang mutlak
findings.suggested: ini adalah perbedaan secara aksidental, bukan perbedaan pada dirinya
findings.why: Per se must not be 'mutlak' (reserved for simpliciter, pelajaran q.7); also in respondeo[1] 'hakiki' → 'pada dirinya'.

findings.latin: ut dicitur in IV Physic. ... cum infinitum non sit mensurabile; sed mensuraret quamlibet circulationem
findings.current: (no reference) ... sebab yang tak terhingga tidak dapat diukur; waktu hanya akan menjadi ukuran bagi bagian peredarannya
findings.suggested: seperti dikatakan dalam Phys. iv ... sebab yang tak terbatas tidak dapat diukur; waktu hanya akan mengukur setiap putarannya
findings.why: Time would measure each whole revolution (which has a beginning and end), not 'that part' of a revolution; the Aristotle reference was dropped; infinitum → tak terbatas.

findings.latin: differens ratione (×2) ... alternatur ratione ... et subiecto et ratione
findings.current: aspeknya (×4)
findings.suggested: pengertiannya
findings.why: Unified terms: ratio as the notion over against the subject → pengertian.

findings.latin: aeternitas est propria mensura ipsius esse
findings.current: ukuran yang khas bagi keberadaan yang tetap
findings.suggested: ukuran yang khas bagi keberadaan itu sendiri
findings.why: 'Permanent' is added by the English; Thomas says eternity is the proper measure of esse itself.

findings.latin: creaturam spiritualem; creaturae spirituales; aliquod creatum sit infinitum; duratio aevi est infinita
findings.current: makhluk rohani; makhluk ciptaan ... tidak terhingga
findings.suggested: ciptaan rohani; suatu ciptaan ... tak terbatas
findings.why: Unified terms creatura → ciptaan, infinitum → tak terbatas.

findings.latin: dicitur enim Eccli. I, quod sapientia aeterna est ante aevum
findings.current: (Sir 1:1) bahwa "Hikmat" yang kekal "ada sebelum zaman"
findings.suggested: bahwa Hikmat yang kekal "ada sebelum eviternitas" (Sir 1:1, Vulg.)
findings.why: The objection proves that aevum is not eternity from the word aevum, so 'zaman' breaks it; 'est ante aevum' is only in the Vulgate (Catholic Sir 1:1 has 'selama-lamanya'); de ratione → pengertian.

findings.latin: qui tempus ab aevo ire iubes
findings.current: Engkau yang memerintahkan agar waktu terpisah dari eviternitas
findings.suggested: Engkau yang menyuruh waktu berjalan keluar dari eviternitas
findings.why: Boethius says time goes forth from aevum, not that it is separated from it.

findings.latin: vel etiam si quandoque deficerent, quod Deo possibile esset
findings.current: suatu saat dapat berhenti ada, yang mungkin diizinkan oleh Allah
findings.suggested: suatu saat berhenti ada, hal yang mungkin bagi Allah
findings.why: Thomas says their ceasing would be possible to God (His power), not that God might perhaps permit it; the modal 'dapat' was added.

findings.latin: Si igitur ipsum aeviternum non sit inveterabile nec innovabile, hoc erit quia esse eius est intransmutabile. Mensura ergo eius non habebit prius et posterius. Est ergo dicendum
findings.current: kenyataan bahwa sesuatu yang eviternal tidak menjadi tua ... berasal dari ketidakberubahannya; akibatnya, ukurannya tidak mengandung ... Maka, kami katakan
findings.suggested: jika sesuatu yang eviternal tidak dapat menjadi tua dan tidak dapat diperbarui, hal itu karena keberadaannya tidak dapat berubah; akibatnya, ukurannya tidak akan mengandung ... Maka, harus dikatakan
findings.why: Thomas is refuting the opponents from their own premise (conditional, future), not stating a fact; 'est dicendum' is impersonal.

findings.latin: habent esse intransmutabile cum transmutabilitate secundum electionem, quantum ad eorum naturam pertinet; ... et locorum suo modo
findings.current: keberadaan mereka tidak dapat berubah menurut kodratnya, tetapi mereka dapat berubah dalam hal pilihan ... sesuai dengan tingkat mereka sendiri
findings.suggested: keberadaan mereka tidak dapat berubah, tetapi, sejauh menyangkut kodrat mereka, mereka dapat berubah dalam hal pilihan ... sesuai dengan cara mereka sendiri
findings.why: 'Quantum ad eorum naturam pertinet' qualifies the changeability of choice (by nature, not as confirmed in glory, cf. I q.62 a.8, q.64 a.2), not the unchangeable being; the English shift made the angels' choice changeable without qualification.

findings.latin: quantum ad affectiones et intelligentias, in quibus est successio ... Quantum vero ad eorum esse naturale
findings.current: dalam hal afeksi dan pemahaman yang silih berganti ... dalam hal kodratnya
findings.suggested: dalam hal afeksi dan pemahaman, yang di dalamnya ada pergantian ... dalam hal keberadaan kodratinya
findings.why: Esse was dropped (the reply measures their natural being, matching the respondeo); successio → pergantian.

findings.latin: sed solum secundum adiunctas mutationes
findings.current: hanya ada dalam hal perubahan aksidental
findings.suggested: hanya ada menurut perubahan-perubahan yang menyertainya
findings.why: The reply refers back to the respondeo's 'transmutatio adiuncta'; 'aksidental' introduces per accidens, which is not in the Latin.

findings.latin: quod non finiatur quodam alio
findings.current: tidak dibatasi oleh makhluk lain mana pun
findings.suggested: tidak dibatasi oleh sesuatu yang lain
findings.why: The Latin says 'by something else', not 'by another creature'.

findings.latin: maiestas et potestas aevorum est apud te
findings.current: kuasa zaman-zaman
findings.suggested: kuasa eviternitas-eviternitas
findings.why: The objection argues from the plural of aevum, and ad 1 answers by explaining that aevum is sometimes taken for saeculum; with 'zaman' the objection has no force.

findings.latin: primus motus, qui prius tempore mensuratur
findings.current: gerak pertama, yang diukur oleh waktu
findings.suggested: gerak pertama, yang lebih dahulu diukur oleh waktu
findings.why: 'Prius' was dropped.

findings.latin: Quid autem horum verius sit, oportet considerare ... devenimus
findings.current: Mana di antara keduanya yang benar dapat ditimbang ... kita dapat naik
findings.suggested: Mana di antara keduanya yang lebih benar harus ditimbang ... kita sampai
findings.why: Comparative verius, oportet (not 'dapat'), and the indicative devenimus restored.

findings.latin: et maxime remoto, non sunt unum simpliciter sed secundum quid ... omnes alii mensurantur, ut dicitur in X Metaphys.
findings.current: terutama bila berjauhan, bukanlah satu secara mutlak, melainkan secara aksidental ... diukur olehnya.
findings.suggested: terutama bila prinsip atau subjek itu jauh, bukanlah satu secara mutlak, melainkan dalam arti tertentu ... diukur olehnya, seperti dikatakan dalam Metaph. x.
findings.why: Secundum quid is not per accidens (pelajaran q.5); remoto qualifies the principle or subject, not the things; the English drops the Metaphysics reference; continuus → kontinu (unified).

findings.latin: plura aeviterna prima aequalia ... simplicissimo sui generis, ut dicitur in X Metaphys., ... esse primi aeviterni, quod tanto est simplicius, quanto prius
findings.current: hal-hal eviternal pada tingkat pertama ... unsur yang paling sederhana dalam genusnya ... yang semakin sederhana semakin dekat ia dengan yang pertama
findings.suggested: hal-hal eviternal pertama yang setara ... yang paling sederhana dalam genusnya, seperti dikatakan dalam Metaph. x, ... yang semakin sederhana sejauh ia semakin dahulu
findings.why: The first aeviternal is simplest because it is prior; the English 'nearer to the first' makes the first thing measure itself against another; 'aequalia' (the point of Origen's view) and the reference were dropped.

findings.current: 11 notes
findings.suggested: 2 notes
findings.why: Resolved queries (a1 sed contra, Rm 16:25 plural, Douay notes, a5 title, kami, Scripture numbering) and terms now in istilah-seragam were pruned.

lessons: [asal: STh I q.10] The 1920 English drops minor premises of objections (a2 obj 1: 'Sed aeternitas est aliquid factum'). Check that every Sed/autem step of each syllogism is present.

[asal: STh I q.10] When an objection proves its point from a word in a Scripture quotation (aevum in Sir 1:1 Vulg. and 3 Esdras; tempora aeterna in Rm 16:25), render that word with the article's technical term and in the Latin number (plural), and mark the quotation (Vulg.) if the phrase is Vulgate-only.
[asal: STh I q.10] Time is numerus motus, not mensura: the English slips into 'measure' of before and after. Keep 'bilangan' for numerus throughout q.10.
[asal: STh I q.10] Check the scope of limiting phrases like 'quantum ad eorum naturam pertinet' (a5 resp): the English attaches them to the wrong clause, which can shift doctrine on the angels.
[asal: STh I q.10] 'Quod tanto est simplicius, quanto prius' = the more prior, the simpler. Tanto ... quanto correlatives must not become 'the nearer to the first'.

[asal: STh I q.10] Psalm references: Catholic (imankatolik) numbering = Hebrew verse minus one for one-verse titles, and ayat.json texts confirm it (Mzm 75:5 = Heb 75:6; Mzm 80:16 = Heb 80:17). So Vulg. 75:5 → Mzm 76:4 and Vulg. 80:16 → Mzm 81:15, but always re-check with ayat.py.

glossary_proposals.alasan: Keeps Boethius's negative term distinct from infinitum → tak terbatas; a1 obj 1 relies on its negative form.
Defining note of eternity, repeated in a1-a6; must never vary (the English 'omni-simultaneous' in a1 obj 4 had led to 'sepenuhnya serentak').
glossary_proposals.rujukan: STh I q.10 a.1, a.4, a.5

glossary_proposals.alasan: Boethius's definition; habitus → 'keadaan memiliki' keeps it distinct (istilah-seragam §C).
Paired technical terms in a5; plain Indonesian is clearer than loanwords.
